title: Reader Chapter 28
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Ludo freezes the porch video on his phone
examples.scenario: Ludo turns a phone with a paused doorbell clip at Sunday 4:08 p.m. in the split-level living room in Parma, homeowner, with mud on the welcome mat. 'You came in with shoes,' Ludo says. His niece points at the screen. 'I was carrying your dog.' The video shows both: muddy shoes and a shaking terrier. Ludo he has to choose between proving the shoe rule and asking what each of them was trying to handle.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Odette twists the wet dish towel
examples.scenario: Odette touches a wet dish towel at Sunday 8:41 p.m. in the galley kitchen of apartment 4B, partner, with a pan soaking with rice stuck to the bottom. Her partner says he forgot the dinner with her parents. Odette is ready to argue calendars. The towel tightens in her hands because the real feeling is embarrassment, not scheduling. Odette she must decide whether to accuse him of not caring or say what feeling is already steering her.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
